confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live menus, booking pages, or listings. Restaurant anchors are moderately uncertain (about ±30%). Accommodation anchors are less certain and July is peak safari season, so hotel and hostel rates may run high. Beer, cocktail and wine rely partly on the beer-relative basis because direct knowledge of bar prices is weak. The RBA FX observation could not be verified: the search returned only an older RBA snapshot, unlabelled homepage figures, and third-party aggregators, so the fx fields are null rather than guessed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on East African safari-gateway towns with Tanzanian local price levels and tourist-facing pricing, roughly comparable to Moshi and similar northern Tanzanian tourism hubs. Wine and cocktail estimates use the local beer relationship as a fallback basis.
